description_en: Updates the basic information about a user-defined function (UDF) in DataStudio. This API operation performs an incremental update. The update information is described by using FlowSpec
description_zh: 调用此接口，可以更新udf函数信息。更新以增量更新的方式进行，更新信息通过FlowSpec格式描述
name: UpdateFunction

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面查看ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the UDF.

This field is of the Long type in SDK versions prior to 8.0.0, and of the String type in SDK versions 8.0.0 and later. This change does not affect normal SDK usage; the parameter will still be returned according to the type defined in the SDK.. However, compilation failures may occur due to the type change only when upgrading the SDK across version 8.0.0. In this case, you must manually update the data type
parameters.help_zh:
udf函数的唯一标识符。

<notice>该字段在SDK8.0.0版本之前为Long类型，SDK8.0.0版本及之后为String类型。该变更不影响SDK正常使用，参数仍会按SDK中定义的类型返回。只有在跨8.0.0版本的SDK升级时，类型变更可能会导致项目编译不通过，需要用户手动修正数据类型。></notice>
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the UDF.

Prior to SDK version 8.0.0, this field is of type Long. In SDK version 8.0.0 and later, it is of type String. This change does not affect the normal use of the SDK. The parameter is returned based on the type defined in the SDK. Compilation failures caused by the type change may occur only when you upgrade the SDK across version 8.0.0. In this case, you must manually update the data type
parameters.help_zh: 描述这个udf函数的FlowSpec信息，具体规范详见FlowSpec (https://github.com/aliyun/dataworks-spec/blob/master/README_zh_CN.md)
parameters.name: spec

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
